judge.voice: Finally a topic that feels like the speaking exam: phones in class, with Sam asking me how my rule would stop cheating. The questions were properly B2, not pet small talk, and the "interested about" fix was exactly right, with the rule. I liked saying it again myself. But I used "actual information" and nobody told me, and that is exactly my freezing point, so I can't fully trust that I've been checked. When I asked "Was my sentence correct?" I got a yes, which was fine but a little polite-classmate. I'd use it again for opinion practice, but I'd still keep my notebook for false friends. Worth telling classmates about if the corrections get sharper.
